backdrop.$description: Full-screen grounds: the base see-through over the world behind menus and dialogs, solid on the full screens, the danger colour and the bands of the loud moments.

dim.$description: (agent) The base at 87 % over the world behind the suit menu: the target's .dim is 50 % over a dark ship; light and dim text keep 4.5:1 over a white world (the contrast gates).

deep.$description: (agent) The base at 90 % over the world behind a dialog.

night.$description: The solid base #1A1629: the ground of the full screens (loading, connecting).

full-screen.$description: The solid base: the ground of the loud full screens (the role reveal, the ends) under their band.

alert.$description: The cops' end: the whole screen in the danger colour (the target's cops ending); its text is ToyTextOnDanger and ToyTitleHeroAlert.

screen-edge-alert.$description: The cops' minute: a 12 px danger edge around the whole screen (the target's 8 px x 1.5), drawn over the HUD, its middle clear.

band.$description: A loud moment's band (the role reveal for an alien, the aliens' win): the accent across the whole width, 285 px tall in the screens (the target's 190 x 1.5), its title ToyTitleHero in the accent ink.

band-alert.$description: The danger band (the role reveal for a human, the humans' and the cops' ends): as ToyBand in the danger colour, its title ToyTitleHeroAlert in the danger ink.
